description: Have the routes (and customer notifications) for a date been sent to drivers, when, and are they the live routes? Optionally counts routes added, modified or removed since sending. Omit date for the currently live date. OptimoRoute: GET /get_dispatch_status.

date.description: Date to check, YYYY-MM-DD. Omit for the live routes' date.

includeRouteChanges.description: Include counts of routes changed since sending.

name: optimoroute_get_dispatch_status
